title.narrative: Early childhood development and parenting strategies and programmes benefited 66,000 children and over 93,000 parents. By supporting the scaling up of gender-transformative parenting models, caring for caregivers, and family-centred early childhood intervention (FECI), UNICEF Serbia contributed to strengthened systemic national and local frameworks. The programme also improved access to quality services for vulnerable populations through enhanced partnerships, advocacy and leveraging public financing for children.;
